module CombinationalCircuit (
    input a,
    input b,
    input c,
    input d,
    output reg q
);
    always @(*) begin
        q = a & ~b & c | a & b & ~d;
    end
endmodule

module CombCircuit (
    input  a,
    input  b,
    input  c,
    input  d,
    output reg q
);
    always @(*) begin
        q = a & ~b & ~c & d | a & b & ~c & ~d | a & b & c & d | a & ~b & c & ~d;
    end
endmodule
